item.title: Taze Adam 2.2.2 Update
item.description:
Taze Adam v2.2.2 has been released!

This update adds Level Repositories, a way to share your levels with other players. If you want to learn how, this GitHub repo will help.

Changelog:

- Added Level Repositories

- Updated the UI (the trees no longer float)

- Updated the Taze Adam Logo

- Changed the format of saved levels

  This also fixes saving of rotated trampolines

  They show the name of the author below the level name, which can be changed in the options

  Old levels will still work and they will be updated when saved

- Added a UI scale slider to the options

- The dropdowns in the level editor are now translated

- Language files are now stored in StreamingAssets and can be modified

- Added a new cursor for dragging in the editor

- The Open Level Directory button now appears and works on macOS

- Added numbers for sliders

- The More Games menu now loads the games from the Taze Adam website, and is always up to date

- Improved update menu

item.title: Taze Adam's 3rd Anniversary
item.description:
Taze Adam is now 3 years old!

For this very special day, I have a special release for you.

Introducing... (drum roll) 



Taze Adam v1.0 for Windows and Linux!

The original release of v1.0 only supported macOS and WebGL, and I couldn't just build for Windows and Linux as the project files for this release are gone, but using some super cool magical methods (i literally just copied some files from the macOS build of v1.0 to the Windows and Linux build of v1.1 and it somehow worked) I was able to port this old release to Windows and Linux!

So what's so special about this version anyway?

Well...



It's literally the same as v1.1 but it cuts off at the 5th checkpoint of Level 1. That's it. But the anniversary is not a multiple of five so I don't have to do anything special anyway.

Anyways, here are the downloads:

Downloads

item.title: Taze Adam 2.2 Update
item.description:
Taze Adam 2.2 has been released on Google Play and itch.io! The game might™ also return to the App Store soon.


Here is the changelog:

Added trampolines

Added object and tile coloring, alongside white tiles

Added new textures

Added Spinning Saws and animations to Water Top and Lava Top tiles (Forgot to write this one in Google Play, oops)

Rearranged options menu

Added autosave to the editor

Added tilemap hiding to the editor

Added a placement preview to the editor

Added a new tilemap: Ladders

- They are tiles that you can jump in, like water

Removed account system

- It barely worked anyway

Added a play mode to custom levels

- You can access the editor by pressing the edit button

Added update notifications for future updates

Added an editor guide

Added an option to increase FPS on mobile

item.title: Taze Adam 2.2.1 Update
item.description:
Taze Adam v2.2.1 has been released on Windows, macOS and Linux! Android and WebGL might™ be Coming Soon™

App Store and Google Play releases are Not Coming™


v2.2.1 also updates the game  to Unity 6 which means the Made with Unity logo will no longer appear on startup. Unity 6 also increases the system requirements for the game, which means the game will now requires Windows 10 21H1, macOS 11, Ubuntu 22.04/24.04, iOS 13 and Android 6.0. Despite these ridiculous system requirements, the game still runs on Windows 32-Bit somehow. That's good news for all the 15 Windows 10 32-Bit users out there.

Thanks to Unity 6, this update also features a Windows ARM build. I honestly have no idea if it works or not, I don't have any devices to test it. The installer also isn't supported on Windows ARM. 

I hope this was good enough to make up for the lack of Windows 7 support.


Here is the update changelog:

- The level string in the editor is now an Input Field, and can be edited.

  Editing it will change where the level is saved.

  You can also enable "Show Full Level Path" in the options to make this show the full path to the level.

- Transitions within the menus are now faster, and will not restart the music.

- The Level Select and Options menus have been redesigned with a new tabbed UI.

- Added consistent select and highlight colors for all the UI.

- The editor toggles are now available in the Options menu, in their own "Editor" tab

- Controller support has (hopefully) been fixed thanks to Unity's new Input System.

- Menu navigation with arrow keys and controllers has been fixed.

  Pressing PgUp, PgDown/L1,R1 will change the menu tab.

- Controller tooltips are now more consistent.

- Added a new loading screen when transitioning between the menu and game.

- Added launch arguments to the game when launching it from the command-line.

  See https://spacechuck.github.io/taze-adam/other/tazeadamargs.html for more information.
